prompts:
Edit this educational poster into a completely recomposed WIDE LANDSCAPE 16:9 image, preferably 2304x1296 or 1536x864. This is a layout redesign, do NOT rotate, stretch, shrink the portrait into a landscape canvas, or crop away information. Fill the full landscape canvas with the redesigned educational composition. Preserve the charming warm clay miniature park style, teal peach cream gold palette, correct English examples and excellent legible typography. Reduce giant title area and decorative frames so most area teaches. Title across top: "TIME PREPOSITIONS". Main body THREE SIDE-BY-SIDE equal-width panels reading left-to-right IN, ON, AT. Footer full-width strip.
LEFT IN panel: title "IN", small category text "Years • Months • Seasons". Use a compact 2 by 2 miniature arrangement of snowman winter, falling autumn leaves, year calendar, floral month calendar. Exact labels "in winter", "in autumn", "in 2024", "in April". Below a compact row of three sun/sky icons with exact labels "in the morning", "in the afternoon", "in the evening"; allow two lines per label if needed, large readable print.
CENTER ON panel: title "ON", small text "Days • Dates". Arrange Monday calendar, December 25 circled calendar, birthday cake with circled date, sunrise and Monday calendar in a clear 2 by 2 layout. Exact labels "on Monday", "on December 25", "on my birthday", "on Monday morning". A small friendly clay child may point to Monday.
RIGHT AT panel: title "AT", small text "Times • Noon • Night". Clock tower at exactly five o'clock with sunset and label "at 5:00 p.m.". Below four mini sun/moon scenes in a 2 by 2 arrangement, exact labels "at 7:00 a.m.", "at noon", "at midnight", "at night". Noon sunny, midnight and night moon/starry.
FULL WIDTH BOTTOM STRIP: heading "NO PREPOSITION", followed horizontally by exact separate phrases "this morning", "next Monday", "last year", "every day". No prepended prepositions.
All content from reference must remain, but reordered for landscape. Strong margins and column gutters, no text overlaps, no tiny lettering. English only, no watermark. Output must be landscape with width markedly greater than height, ideal 16:9.

Edit this educational poster into a completely recomposed WIDE LANDSCAPE 16:9 image, preferably 2304x1296 or 1536x864. Redesign the composition to use full width, NOT rotate, stretch or letterbox the portrait. Preserve charming warm clay park miniature style, teal peach cream gold, readable accurate English text. Title "MORE TIME PREPOSITIONS" in a modest top header. Use a precise TWO-ROW dashboard of illustrated educational panels: upper row THREE equal-width panels; lower row TWO equal-width panels. Generous gutters and very readable labels, small decoration, each educational concept given enough space.
UPPER LEFT panel: "BEFORE / AFTER". Two small lunch scenes side by side, untouched lunch then empty plate, connecting arrow. Exact labels "before lunch", "after lunch".
UPPER CENTER panel: "FROM ... TO ...". One school miniature above a long horizontal timeline with clock endpoints nine and five. Exact caption "from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.", subtitle "Start → End". Clock hands must match nine and five.
UPPER RIGHT panel: "BY / UNTIL". Two mini rows, first finished drawing with completion check at or before 5:00 p.m., exact sentence "Finish by 5:00 p.m." and sublabel "Deadline". Second drawing child with continuous blue band ending 5:00 p.m., exact sentence "Work until 5:00 p.m." and sublabel "Continue to this time". Show deadline versus continuation distinctly.
LOWER LEFT WIDE panel: "FOR / SINCE / DURING". Three evenly spaced miniature columns. Reading child and bracket spanning two hours caption "for two hours", sublabel "How long". Monday calendar and line extending from Monday to NOW caption "since Monday", sublabel "From a starting point". Small meeting scene caption "during the meeting", sublabel "When something happens".
LOWER RIGHT WIDE panel: "IN / WITHIN". Two evenly spaced miniature columns with timeline NOW to +2 hours and child returning. Left single arrival exactly at +2 hours, caption "I'll be back in two hours.", sublabel "Two hours from now". Right green completion tick strictly inside shaded interval and endpoint +2 hours, caption "I'll be back within two hours.", sublabel "No later than two hours from now". Captions may wrap to two lines for readability. Arrow/tick endpoints mathematically clear, no extraneous times.
Retain all five groups from reference, accurate full examples, no missing panels. English only, no watermark, no text overlap or clipped margins. It MUST be landscape with width greater than height, ideal 16:9.
